com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth

Interface BookByPriceRecord

  • All Superinterfaces:
    MarketDepth
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultBookByPriceRecord

    public interface BookByPriceRecord
extends MarketDepth
    Purpose of this class is to hold the additional properties for the Book By Price Record Depth information of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types. The properties of Market Maker are represented as Bid and Ask objects which are considered to be Market Depth records. Each Market Depth record contains market maker, time stamp and Bid/Ask values. It also contains the operation (add/update etc.) which should be applied on given Bid/Ask values. The Book By Price Record Depth Record also holds the Order Count and the Exchange Id.
    Since:
